companies.lede: Sourced profiles of companies in my 2026–27 job search: mission, funding, headcount, engineering, news and the questions I'd ask.

items.title: NetBox Labs
items.summary: Commercial steward of open-source NetBox; Series B ($55M raised), ~130 people, fully remote, repositioning around AI data centers and agents.

items.title: iii (formerly Motia)
items.summary: Tiny open-core Rust agent/workflow engine (~18.9k stars); no public funding found, legal entity unclear.

items.title: LaunchDarkly
items.summary: Feature management leader, $200M+ ARR, private since a 2021 $3B Series D; betting on AgentControl for AI agents. Background notes only.

items.title: Parasail
items.summary: Pay-per-token inference cloud for AI startups; Series A ($42M raised), 49 on LinkedIn and doubling yearly, San Mateo; risk: price war, thin capital for an owned GPU fleet

items.title: Resolve AI
items.summary: AI SRE ('AI for prod') from the ex-Splunk Observability founders; Series A at $1.5B, $190M+ raised, ~166 people (~70 eng); headcount flat for 6 months, valuation far ahead of ~$4M reported ARR.

items.title: BetterUp
items.summary: Enterprise human + AI coaching platform, private (last priced 2021 at $4.7B, secondary est. $0.9B), 501–1,000 staff band; weak culture scores, hiring down sharply

items.title: ParentSquare
items.summary: K-12 school-family communication platform (owns Remind), founder-led, Serent-backed (~$58M raised per Form D), ~418 staff remote-first; headline risks are a likely PE exit, slowing hiring and CTO-level churn.

items.title: Infosys
items.summary: Indian IT services giant (NYSE: INFY), ~332.5K staff; profitable but growth stalled at 1-2% and stock hit by AI-disruption fears
